annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ludin, D.; Wellbrock, W.; Müller, E.; Gerstlberger, W.; Gray, L.; Salat, S.
key_provisions_or_claims: Survey of 88 respondents in Germany on robotics in the workplace and business ethics.
Robots bring productivity and safety benefits but threaten low-skilled jobs and raise inequality.
Machine ethics raises issues of safety, job loss and machine decision-making power.
HR must adapt training, occupational health and safety, and anti-discrimination for robot collaboration.
Employee involvement and trust are important in transformation processes.
annotation.summary_en: Preliminary-communication journal article reporting an online survey of 88 employees in Germany on robotics in the workplace through business ethics, mechatronics and HR lenses. It examines opportunities, risks, employee involvement and willingness to collaborate with robots, and highlights job displacement, training and trust issues.
annotation.title_clean: Robotics in the Modern World of Work - Results From an Empirical Study Regarding Business Ethics
annotation.title_en: Robotics in the Modern World of Work - Results From an Empirical Study Regarding Business Ethics
